boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Messiah destinations for studying, gathering, activity and campus events, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: Murray Library
cards.subtitle: Library learning commons • campus map destination
cards.notes: Choose the quiet or chat-friendly study setting that fits your group, then use the co-located Learning or Writing Center when you need academic support.
cards.short_summary: A flexible study stop with research help and academic-support partners in the same building.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s student handbook says Murray Library has quiet and chat-friendly individual and group study spaces and co-locates the Learning Center and Writing Center.
cards.access_notes: Use during library open hours; the library’s visiting guide documents an accessible ramp entrance and elevator access.

cards.title: Larsen Student Union
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination • student gathering space
cards.notes: Check the student-union calendar for a concert or Coffeehouse, or meet friends for a game of pool before moving on to your next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A named union where Messiah documents free student-band concerts, pool and monthly Coffeehouse performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s student-life page identifies the student union as a place for free student-band concerts, pool and monthly Coffeehouse performances.
cards.access_notes: Event availability varies; consult current campus programming before making a trip specifically for a performance.

cards.title: Yellow Breeches Creek
cards.subtitle: Runs through Messiah’s campus
cards.notes: Use the creekside as an outdoor pause between classes; Messiah specifically documents students studying with friends, hammocking, tubing, canoeing and fishing here.
cards.short_summary: The campus waterway is a documented setting for outdoor study, hammocking and water recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah says the Yellow Breeches Creek runs through campus and documents students studying with friends, hammocking, tubing, canoeing and fishing there.
cards.access_notes: Choose a land-based visit unless you have suitable equipment and conditions for water activity; follow campus safety guidance.

cards.title: Parmer Cinema
cards.subtitle: High Center • weekend movie venue
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled weekend screening and bring classmates along; Messiah lists free movies in Parmer Cinema among its on-campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A named campus cinema used for Messiah’s free weekend movie programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s around-campus page states that students can take in a free movie in Parmer Cinema on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Screenings are scheduled events; verify the current arts or student-events calendar for dates and entry details.

cards.title: M. Louise Aughinbaugh Gallery
cards.subtitle: Climenhaga Building • visual-art exhibitions
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition, then watch for artist talks or gallery talks that connect the displayed work with classroom and campus conversation.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with recurring exhibitions that include student, faculty and nationally recognized artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s Art and Design department says the Aughinbaugh Gallery hosts several exhibitions yearly and features work by nationally recognized artists, faculty and students.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition schedules change; check the gallery’s current program before visiting for a particular show or talk.

cards.title: Hostetter Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministries gathering place
cards.notes: If worship or reflection is part of your routine, check the chapel schedule; Messiah identifies Thursday-evening Powerhouse as a student gathering here.
cards.short_summary: A chapel used for student worship, including the documented Thursday-evening Powerhouse gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that students gather at Hostetter Chapel on Thursday evenings for Powerhouse worship and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled programming and follow Chapel attendance and entry policies published by Campus Ministries.

cards.title: Lottie Nelson Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Upper level, Eisenhower Campus Center
cards.notes: Meet over a meal in Messiah’s main dining hall, then use the dining page to confirm the menu and the current academic-year or special hours.
cards.short_summary: Messiah’s main dining hall, located in the Eisenhower Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah Dining Services identifies Lottie Nelson Dining Hall on the upper level of Eisenhower Campus Center as the university’s main dining hall.
cards.access_notes: Meals require a meal plan, Dining Dollars or another accepted payment method; check the dining page for current hours.

cards.title: Sollenberger Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination • indoor recreation
cards.notes: Plan an active break with friends using the center’s courts, indoor track, natatorium or racquetball courts, subject to the facility’s current access rules.
cards.short_summary: An indoor recreation hub with courts, an indoor track, pool and racquetball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah lists basketball courts, an indoor track, a natatorium and racquetball courts among the university’s fitness facilities.
cards.access_notes: Facility access, reservations and equipment procedures can vary; confirm current recreation policies before visiting.

cards.title: Falcon Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination • group fitness
cards.notes: Try a scheduled group-fitness class or build an individual workout; Messiah lists options from stretching through higher-intensity sessions for students and employees.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness center that hosts Messiah group-fitness classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah says Falcon Fitness Center group-fitness classes offer students and employees a range of activities from slow-paced stretching to high-intensity workouts.
cards.access_notes: Check the current group-fitness schedule and facility eligibility requirements before attending.

cards.title: Covered Bridge
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination • route to soccer fields
cards.notes: Use the bridge as a campus landmark on the walk toward the soccer fields, especially when attending the university’s documented Homecoming white-out march.
cards.short_summary: A named campus bridge that anchors Messiah’s documented Homecoming march to the soccer field.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah describes a Homecoming white-out march led by a bagpiper across the Covered Bridge to the soccer field.
cards.access_notes: The march is tied to Homecoming soccer games; consult current Homecoming and athletics schedules for timing.
